entries.desc: Running koala init with --profile=codex|claude|all|core uses the explicit profile as source of truth and reports the selected profile without being changed by host markers or env hints.

evidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:entrypoints
evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, build passed and then the 21-check entrypoint suite verified explicit --profile=codex|claude|all|core selection and output.

entries.desc: Running koala init without --profile resolves the detection matrix as codex for Codex-only markers, claude for Claude-only markers, all for both markers, and all with an explicit compatibility note when no markers are present.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, the 21-check entrypoint suite covers no-profile detection for Codex-only, Claude-only, both-marker, and markerless all fallback.

entries.desc: If both Codex and Claude markers are present, detection chooses all instead of preferring one host implicitly.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, detection tests include both host markers and assert all profile is selected.

entries.desc: If no host markers are present, init keeps the backward-compatible all profile and prints a note that detection fell back rather than silently pretending a host-specific choice was made.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, default fallback test asserts markerless init prints the backward-compatibility all-profile note.

entries.desc: Host marker or env detection must never override an explicit --profile request, even when the requested profile conflicts with detected markers.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, explicit override test seeds a Codex marker, requests --profile claude, and asserts explicit profile wins over detected markers.

entries.desc: codex profile generates KOALA.md, core docs/config assets, bin/koala.js, AGENTS.md, .Codex/README.md, .Codex/koala.json, .Codex/agents, and bin/koala-codex.js while skipping CLAUDE.md and .claude-only assets.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, profile matrix tests assert codex profile creates KOALA.md, AGENTS.md, .Codex assets, bin/koala.js, and bin/koala-codex.js while omitting Claude-only assets.

entries.desc: claude profile generates KOALA.md, core docs/config assets, bin/koala.js, CLAUDE.md, .claude/agents, .claude/skills/koala, .claude/hooks, and .claude/settings.json while skipping .Codex assets and bin/koala-codex.js.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, profile matrix tests assert claude profile creates KOALA.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude assets, and bin/koala.js while omitting .Codex assets and bin/koala-codex.js.

entries.desc: all profile preserves dual-stack generation, and core profile generates only the neutral core assets plus KOALA.md without any host adapter files.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, profile matrix tests assert all profile emits both adapters and core profile emits neutral assets plus KOALA.md only.

entries.desc: Existing AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or KOALA.md files that contain koala markers sync only the managed koala section and leave user content outside the markers unchanged.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, managed marker-sync tests assert AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and KOALA.md preserve user content around markers while replacing only the managed section.

entries.desc: Existing user-owned AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or KOALA.md files without koala markers are preserved and skipped instead of being overwritten.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, unmanaged-doc tests assert unmarked AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and KOALA.md are preserved byte-for-byte and logged as skipped.

entries.desc: The asset matrix is mechanical: a host-specific profile must not leak the other host adapter files or overwrite unmarked user-owned files in order to make init appear successful.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, transition tests all->codex, codex->claude, and all->core assert stale Koala-managed wrong-host assets are removed while unmarked top-level docs are preserved.

entries.desc: Hard-coded contract coverage passes for the init profile matrix and existing-file preservation, and fails if generated assets no longer match the selected profile rules.

evidence.command: npm run build && npm run test:entrypoints
evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, build passed and the hard-coded 21-check contract suite passed, covering profile matrix, re-init cleanup, preservation, explicit override, and verification skip behavior.

entries.desc: codex and all profiles that generate .Codex assets continue to require Codex adapter verification as part of their contract coverage.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, Codex adapter verification passes; the global fallback line is advisory-only for worktree-local verification.

entries.desc: claude and core profiles do not call or require runCodexAdapterChecks during normal init validation when they generate no .Codex assets.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, non-Codex profile tests assert claude/core normal matrix behavior without invoking Codex adapter checks.

entries.desc: When --verify-codex is explicitly requested for claude or core, the command explains that the selected profile has no Codex adapter assets instead of reporting missing .Codex files as adapter drift.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, explicit --verify-codex tests for claude/core assert a clear skip message rather than missing-.Codex drift failures.

entries.desc: Coverage must catch wrong-profile asset generation or unmarked existing-file overwrite regressions rather than passing because the tests only assert successful command exit.

evidence.note: At current HEAD b050f198, contract tests assert present/absent assets, transition cleanup, and marker semantics so command success alone cannot hide wrong-profile generation.
